pages.text: Every night, Ddori hugged a blanket to sleep. Yesterday, broth spilled on it.
Bung washed it, wanting it soft and dry by night.
Bung hung it on the line by the boat edge. The sun shone bright.
Bung played with Ddori, counting floating leaves. One, two, three.
Clouds gathered, darkening the sky. Bung only counted leaves.
Rain poured. Bung ran, but the blanket was already soaked.
At night, Ddori felt around for the dry blanket.
Grandpa squeezed the wet blanket hard in both hands. "The sky grew dark first."
Next day, Bung gathered the hanging blanket into both arms. The sky was darkening again.
At night, Ddori hugged the soft, dry blanket and soon slept peacefully.
